sales_description: Philips Zoom NiteWhite ACP 22% is a professional take-home whitening gel formulated with 22% Carbamide Peroxide. Features Amorphous Calcium Phosphate (ACP) technology to reduce sensitivity, protect enamel, and improve tooth luster. Designed for overnight wear or 2-4 hours daily use in custom trays.

Philips Zoom Chairside Light-Activated Whitening Kit (WhiteSpeed) is a professional in-office system designed for up to 8 shades of whitening in 45 minutes. Includes proprietary whitening gel with 25% Hydrogen Peroxide and ACP, plus necessary barrier materials (LiquidDam, IsoPrep retractors) for complete patient protection.

Comprehensive Philips Zoom WhiteSpeed In-Office Whitening Kit (2 Patients) bundled with Take-Home Touch-Up Maintenance. Includes professional Chairside Gel (25% H2O2), barrier materials, PLUS post-care maintenance gel or pen to sustain whitening results.

Philips Zoom Protective Eyewear is designed for patient and clinician safety during light-activated whitening procedures. Features specialized orange polycarbonate lenses that block 99% of UVA/UVB and blue LED light emissions, ensuring optimal eye protection.

The Philips Zoom WhiteSpeed (Advance Power) Lamp is a professional LED whitening accelerator. Emits an optimal blue light spectrum to activate Zoom whitening gel, accelerating the breakdown of stains. Features adjustable intensity settings and proven results of up to 8 shades whiter.
